result.title: Agentic Ensemble with Vision-Language Models for Visual Anomaly Detection
result.summary: Visual anomaly detection aims to detect abnormal objects, while anomaly samples are often scarce during model training. Assembling multiple pretrained detectors can help by leveraging their transferable image scores and anomaly maps. However, most existing ensemble methods apply fixed fusion rules over saved predictions which struggle when pretrained detectors clearly disagree due to different training objectives, priors, and visual representations. To this end, we design AnomalyAgent, a post-training fusion framework for accurate visual anomaly detection. AnomalyAgent aligns heterogeneous scores and maps, summarizes score- and region-level disagreement, and treats fusion as a finite action-selection problem. It implements two types of actions: 1) score actions that determine how to fuse image-level detector confidence via consensus, robust aggregation, detector weighting, or score-map consistency; 2) map actions that fuse dense anomaly responses via consensus, detector weighting, geometric aggregation, or disagreement correction. A constrained vision-language model (VLM) is introduced to inspect high-conflict samples and select valid score action and map action to produce the final prediction. We evaluate AnomalyAgent on MVTec AD and VisA as primary benchmarks, together with seven additional public anomaly benchmarks and Real-IAD for large-scale score-level evaluation. Across these benchmarks, AnomalyAgent consistently improves over equal-weight fusion and achieves the best mean image AUROC and pixel AP among the compared fusion methods on MVTec AD and VisA, while demonstrating robust transfer across additional anomaly domains.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 AnomalyAgent，一个训练后的融合框架：先对齐多个预训练视觉异常检测器的分数与异常图，归纳分数级和区域级分歧，再用受约束的 VLM 检查高冲突样本，从若干分数动作与图动作中选定组合以产生最终预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「按分歧程度触发 VLM 介入并选择证据融合动作」的做法，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、何时投入额外计算的 LOOK/STOP 决策提供概念类比，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态，需较多核查。
